newsitem.title: USA: Calif. official seeks Golden Eagle Insurance funds.
newsitem.headline: Calif. official seeks Golden Eagle Insurance funds.

text.p: California's insurance commissioner on Monday demanded the return of $69 million in unsecured loans owed to Golden Eagle/Mesa Reinsurance and threatened to sue to recover the funds.

Commissioner Chuck Quackenbush said he issued a letter demanding that John Mabee, the former owner of both companies, return the $69 million he owes Mesa Reinsurance so that the funds will be available to Golden Eagle policyholders.
"If that demand is not met, I am prepared to file a lawsuit to recover the millions of missing dollars," Quackenbush said in a statement.
Last month, Quackenbush served a court order to take over control and operation of San Diego-based Golden Eagle Insurance Co, which was privately held.
The order also included putting Mesa Reinsurance into the conservatorship.
